_about: The Weapon Techniques written in the card Structure (book/cards/card-structure.md): the two Basic bows of the Bow remake, decided with Lucas on 2026-11-16 (book/cards/bows-redesign.md). THE BOOK reads these; Foundry and the ruler still read ../gear.json (its Skirmish Shot and Heartseeker are set aside in the book) until the Foundry pass. 'weapon' names the Technique's weapon; 'mastery' the Mastery that unlocks it.

cards.name: Wounding Shot
cards.flavor: You hold your ground until your foe shows its flank, and put a broad-headed arrow where the wound will not close.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: You haven't left your square this turn.

cards.name: Circling Shot
cards.flavor: You circle your foe as you draw, and loose from the side it has left open.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod]; you Evade 1 to a square that is no farther from the target.
